chapter: Southern Illinois roadhouse and St. Louis
title: His brief shotgun marriage to Martel's daughter
summary: Joe says he and the Martel girl stayed together only a few weeks; she never traveled with him.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Where was your wife at this time? Did you leave your wife?
Oh, we had separated. Completely separated.
Oh, yeah. We only stayed together for maybe two or three weeks. It was kind of a shotgun wedding, to tell you the truth.
Well, she never traveled with me. Now I'm talking about the Martel girl.
She stayed home. She never traveled with me at all. She was home all the time. I didn't want to get married to start with, and then I started fighting with that old man. But anyway...
